entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Aaron Glenn announced Friday that Cooper (ankle/groin) will remain out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Parker Washington

entries.name: Zachariah Branch

entries.name: Colston Loveland
entries.summary: Loveland (knee) is slated to get a second opinion on his knee injury and won't be placed on injured reserve for now, though he is considered week-to-week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Davis Allen
entries.summary: Allen is dealing with a high-ankle sprain, according to sources, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports Friday.

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten

entries.name: Brock Purdy

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Watson (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Wednesday's game against the Rams.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (shoulder) had his right arm in a sling following Thursday's 39-38 victory over the Cowboys, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

entries.name: Dalton Schultz

entries.name: Darren Waller

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (shoulder) was listed as a non-participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Denzel Boston
entries.summary: Boston (quadriceps) will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

entries.name: Derrick Henry

entries.name: DeVonta Smith

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: Marks (concussion) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When addressing the press Wednesday, Pierce (heel) noted that the offseason procedure he underwent this past March was done because he was dealing with heel pain that impacted his Achilles, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas

entries.name: Ben Skowronek

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: McMillan (knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) practiced without limitations Friday.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Raheim Sanders
entries.summary: Sanders (hip) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

entries.name: Romeo Doubs
entries.summary: Doubs (shoulder), who remains on injured reserve, has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: The Broncos placed Dobbins on the reserve/suspended list Wednesday, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
